thread:
Ari: heads up - flaky shutdown in our sample app using httpx.AsyncClient + FastAPI. create client at module import, start background poll with `asyncio.create_task`, then on reload we see `Task was destroyed but it is pending!` and unclosed connection warnings. anyone have a clean pattern?
Maya: seen this. uvicorn --reload causes double startup/shutdown sequences. I use explicit `await client.__aenter__()` in startup and `await client.__aexit__()` in shutdown to ensure pool is opened/closed. ugly but works locally.
Jon: that breaks tests where pytest-asyncio runs different loops. we got `Event loop is closed` when aclose ran on a different loop. cross-loop cleanup is painful.
Ari: exactly. also observed retries spamming while shutdown races with token refresh.
Maya: feature idea: SDK should expose `async def start(self):` and `async def stop(self):` to decouple context manager from lifecycle and avoid cross-loop surprises. cancel in-flight retries on stop too.
Jon: typing fix request too: our stubs mark `__aenter__` as Any, causing mypy churn. documented `start()/stop()` would help typing.
ci-bot: tests: nightly integration passed (:white_check_mark:)
Ari: i'll open an issue with repro + suggested API and add a small FastAPI/pytest example for the docs. will ping when ready.
